title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25C (Right of workmen laid-off for compensation)

content.overview: Section 25C gives a laid-off workman a right to compensation at the prescribed rate, subject to the stated conditions.
content.glance: Section 25C gives a laid-off workman a right to compensation at the prescribed rate, subject to the stated conditions.
content.study: A workman who is laid off is entitled to compensation equal to fifty per cent of basic wages and dearness allowance for the laid-off days, subject to the continuous-service and other conditions in Chapter VA.

sections.body: Section 25C gives a laid-off workman a right to compensation at the prescribed rate, subject to the stated conditions.
